teaser: A roomful of people turns toward you before you have said a word. An hour later you have shut the study door and switched off the lamp. Life path 7 asks for solitude and quiet figuring-out; ENFJ pulls toward company, toward reading what a room needs and handing it over. You are the seeker who also leads, the one who studies people for a living and still wants to disappear into a theory of them. That crossing is not a contradiction so much as a weather system: warmth that keeps retreating indoors to check its own instruments.
excerpt: The waiting room chair with the one short leg rocks every time you shift, and you are shifting because the appointment is running late and a partner texts to ask if you are alright.
